subject: maths
question: 400 mangoes were bought at ₹1210 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹960. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of mangoes.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Cost Price (CP) for 400 mangoes = 4 × 1210 = ₹4840

Total Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit = 4840 + 960 = ₹5800

Selling Price per dozen = (Total SP ÷ Total Mangoes) × 12

Selling Price per dozen = (5800 ÷ 400) × 12 = 14.5 × 12 = 174

**∴ The correct answer is ₹174.**
